name: tar creates and lists archives
lines: tar -cvf m.tar /etc/motd; echo s$?; tar -tvf m.tar
tar -cf c.tar --sort=name -C forest cave river; tar -tf c.tar
tar -cf forest/self.tar --sort=name forest; echo s$?; tar -tf forest/self.tar
cd forest; tar -cf ../up.tar ../readme.txt; echo s$?; tar -tf ../up.tar; cd
tar -cf slash.tar library/; tar -tf slash.tar | head -1

name: tar errors
lines: tar -cf x.tar nosuch readme.txt; echo s$?; tar -tf x.tar
tar -cf x.tar /etc/vault.conf /root readme.txt; echo s$?; tar -tf x.tar
tar -cf r.tar readme.txt; tar -tzf r.tar; echo s$?
tar -tf r.tar readme.txt nosuch; echo s$?
chmod 000 r.tar; tar -tf r.tar; echo s$?; chmod 644 r.tar
tar -cf c.tar -C nowhere readme.txt; echo s$?

name: tar extracts archives
lines: tar -cf f.tar --sort=name forest; rm -r forest; tar -xvf f.tar; echo s$?
mkdir out; tar -xf f.tar -C out forest/cave; ls -l out out/forest out/forest/cave
tar -czf l.tgz --sort=name library; mkdir two; tar -xvzf l.tgz --directory=two; ls -l two/library
tar -cf r.tar readme.txt; echo changed > readme.txt; chmod 444 readme.txt; tar -xf r.tar; echo s$?; cat readme.txt; ls -l readme.txt
tar -cf m.tar /etc/motd 2>/dev/null; tar -xvf m.tar; ls -l etc etc/motd
chmod 700 gate/open_gate.sh; tar -cf g.tar gate/open_gate.sh; rm gate/open_gate.sh; tar -xf g.tar; ls -l gate/open_gate.sh
tar -cf w.tar readme.txt; mkdir ro; chmod 555 ro; cd ro; tar -xf ../w.tar; echo s$?; cd

name: gzip, gunzip and zcat
lines: gzip readme.txt; echo s$?; ls readme*
gunzip readme.txt.gz; echo s$?; cat readme.txt; ls -l readme.txt
gzip -k readme.txt; echo s$?; gzip -k readme.txt; echo s$?
gzip -r forest; ls forest forest/cave forest/cave/deep
cp market/inventory.txt fake.gz; gunzip fake.gz; echo s$?
ln -s readme.txt rl; gzip rl; echo s$?
ln readme.txt hl; gzip hl; echo s$?
cp readme.txt t; gzip t; mv t.gz t.tgz; gunzip t.tgz; ls t*

intended.reason: the compressed bytes are the simulator's own encoding (DEFLATE packed seven bits to a character), not gzip's
